name: Moped
description: A motor-driven cycle with foot pedals for human propulsion and a motor of no more than two brake horsepower (1,500 W) that can't propel it past 30 mph on a level road; the traffic code holds only a combustion engine to 50 cc, so an electric motor qualifies. Defined by Wyoming Statutes §31-5-102(a)(xxi); the registration chapter's definition in §31-1-101(a)(xv)(C) is written around a 50 cc cylinder capacity.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and foot pedals that permit muscular propulsion by human power
Its motor produces no more than two brake horsepower (1,500 W) and can't propel it faster than 30 mph on a level road
Anyone licensed to drive any class of vehicle may ride one
No helmet requirement: the minors' helmet law excludes moped riders
Needs at least one head lamp and one tail lamp
